description: Na₃VSi₄(HO₆)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.44 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.78 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.66 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.16 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form VO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.13 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one VO₆ octahedra and corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 59°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.66 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two VO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-49°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.68 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two VO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-44°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.70 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one VO₆ octahedra and corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 57°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.68 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.72 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na, one V, and one Si atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂VSi tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one V, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one V, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, one Si, and one H atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two Na, one V, and one Si atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂VSi tetrahedra. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Si atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na and two Si atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two Na and two H atoms.
